snippet.title: To My Darling FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
To My Darling By ixkyu All Endings Visual Novel Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Mimiko Nakamura, a third year at White Lily Junior High, wants to give her crush a love letter after school. Trouble arises when her classmates have other plans for her.

To My Darling: https://ixkyu.itch.io/to-my-darling
Developer: ixkyu
Genres: Visual Novel
Platforms: Microsoft Windows

0:00 Ending 2 My Darling
40:08 Ending 1 Thank you for Loving me
53:47 Ending 3 At The End of The River, I Met You
1:00:52 Ending 4 My Reflection, My Voice, My Love
